s: Hilkot tepilla uzemannah ubo t' seipim: anshe keneset haggedola tiqqenu lehitpallel bekol yom g' tepillot shel y"ch berakot shehitpalelu haabot, veqabeu shettayim mehen choba, shehen shacharit umincha, keneged b' temidin shehen choba bekol yom, veshel arbit tiqqenu reshut, keneged ebarim upedarim sheim lo nitakkelu mibbeod yom hem qerebim veholekim kol hallayla, abal akshav kebar qibbeluhu kol yisrael alehem lechoba, kemo sheyyitbaer bimqomah. Ukesherabbu haeppiqoresin beyisrael, vehayu metzerin lahem meod, umesitin et haam likpor battora shebbeal peh — amad rabban gamliel ubet dino vehosipu "birkat hamminim" bekol tepillat y"ch. Uzeman hattepillot hu kizman hattemidin, shettamid shel shachar zemanno matchil mishsheala ammud hashshachar, shehu or hannotzetz mehachamma bammizrach, mahalak d' milin qodem netz hachamma. Ella shehayu mamtinim ad sheheir kol pene hammizrach ad shebbechebron, lepi sheppaam achat bau lide taut al yede sheala meor hallebana vedimmu shehu or hannotzetz bammizrach bashshachar. Venimshak zemanno ad sop shaa d' mealot hashshachar, shehu shelish hayyom, shemmikkan veelak eno niqra boqer. Lepikak, gam tepillat hashshachar zemannah matchil mealot hashshachar. Ella shellekattechilla mitzva lehatchil im netz hachamma, dehaynu achar yetziatah velo qodem laken, mishshum shenneemar: "yirauka im shamesh vego'". Verauy lizzaher bazeh bime hasselichot shergilin lehaqdim qodem netz hachamma, veeno nakon. Abal bediabad im abar vehitpallel mishsheala ammud hashshachar — yatza. Veap lekattechilla yakol laasot ken bishat haddechaq, kemo sheyyitbaer. Venimshak zemannah ad sop shelish hayyom, shetztzarik ligmor hattepilla qodem sheyyaabor shelish hayyom, ben shehayyom arok ben shehayyom qatzar. Kegon, im hayyom arok y"ch shaot mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkokabim — shelish hayyom hu v' shaot mishsheala ammud hashshachar. Veim hu t' shaot — shelishito hu g' shaot. Velaken tzarik lizzaher bachorep lehashkim lehitpallel beinyan sheyyigmeru tepillat y"ch qodem shelish hayyom, ap al pi shekkebar qareu qeriat shema beonatah qodem hattepilla, kemo shennitbaer besiman m"v. Veim taa o abar velo hitpallel ad achar shelish hayyom ad chatzot — yatza yede chobat tepilla, abal lo yatza yede chobat tepilla bizmannah. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik lehitpallel bemincha shettayim, lepi sheggam betashlumin shebbemincha en lo sekar tepilla bizmannah:

Vaapillu lekattechilla yakol lehitpallel shacharit ad chatzot im abar velo hitpallel qodem laken, apillu abar bemezid sheen tashlumin bemincha — yesh lo tashlumin ad chatzot, kevan shello higgia adayin zeman tepilla acheret. Abal achar chatzot miyyad, kevan shehiggia kebar zeman tepillat hammincha, ap al pi sheeno yakol lehitpallel mincha ad achar chatzi shaa achar chatzot — zehu mishshum sherob bene adam (enam beqiim) lekavven hashshaot kol kak, abal beemet zemannah matchil miyyad achar chatzot, lepikak en lo tashlumin od litpillat hashshachar. Ella im ken taa o neenas velo hitpallel otah bizmannah. Vegam betaut o ones en lo tashlumin ella lehitpallel mincha shettayim, kelomar shemmittechilla yitpallel mincha shehu chobat shaa, veaz kevan shehu asuq battepilla — chozer umashlim mah shettaa bitpillotayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"ch. Lepikak, tzarik lehamtin chatzi shaa achar chatzot kede lehitpallel mincha techilla, veachar kak yachazor lehitpallel leshem tashlumin shel shacharit. Veim hapak — lo yatza, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Kevan shehiggia zeman tepilla, dehaynu mishsheala ammud hashshachar, asur leadam lehaqdim lepetach chabero litten lo shalom, veremez laddabar shenneemar: "chidlu lakem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki bammeh nechshab hu", kelomar bammeh chashabto lazeh shehiqdamta kebodo likbodi, veiqqar kebodo shel maqom vaabodato hi tepillat y"ch. Ulepikak, apillu hishkim uberak kol birkot hashshachar veamar kamma shirot vetishbachot, vaapillu qibbel alayv ol malkut shamayim biqriat shema beonatah qodem hattepilla — asur lehashkim lepetach chabero litten lo shalom, o apillu lomar lo "tzapra demareh tab" im eno holek ella lehaqbil panayv. Abal im hutzrak laleket lirot ezehu eseq veaggab zeh holek lepetach chabero lomar lo "tzapra demareh tab" — muttar. Abal lo yitten lo shalom, ki shemo shel haqqabba"h shalom, veen zeh kebod hammaqom lechalleq kabod bishmo lebasar vadam qodem shechalaq lo kabod baabodat hattepilla. Veken asur likroa lo al birkayv apillu belo netinat shalom (ki zehu kabod gadol kemo kabod shebbattepilla shekkoreim bah lehaqqadosh baruk hu, veasur lehaqdim ken lebasar vadam). Vehu shemmashkim lepitcho, abal im metzao bashshuq o bebet hakkeneset — yakol likroa lo velitten lo shalom min haddin. Abal nahagu shello litten shalom qodem hattepilla, apillu metzao bashshuq, apillu belo keria, vaapillu hu ragil litten lo shalom bekol yom, ella yomar "tzapra demareh tab", sheal yede shemmeshanneh ballashon — yitten leb shehu asur lehitakkeb bidbarim acherim kelal ad sheyyitpallel, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veyesh oserin likroa al birkayv apillu metzao bashshuq vaapillu belo netinat shalom kelal. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem. Umikkol maqom yesh lehaqel bazeh im hitchil kebar lebarek birkot hashshachar, hoil veissur zeh lo nizkar battalmud ella hu missebara. Abal im hu mashkim lepitcho — asur likroa lo (apillu belo netinat shalom) ad sheyyitpallel y"ch:

Asur leadam lehitasseq bitzrakayv qodem tepillat y"ch bashshachar, kede shello yipneh libbo leshum dabar ad sheyyitpallel. Veyesh nohagin lehaqel bazeh leachar sheameru birkot hashshachar qodem baruk sheamar. Veeno nakon. Veken asur latzet ladderek babboqer ad sheyyitpallel y"ch, ella im ken yotze beshayyara veenah mamtenet lo:

Aseru chakamim leekol o lishtot mishsheala ammud hashshachar ad sheyyitpallel y"ch. Vesameku issur zeh al mah shekkatub: "lo toklu al haddam", kelomar, lo toklu qodem shettitpalelu al damkem. Vekol haokel veshoteh veachar kak mitpallel — alayv hakkatub omer: "veoti hishlakta achare gavveka", al tiqra "gavveka", shemmashmao kol tzorke gupeka, ella "geeka" — leshon gaava, amar haqqabba"h: leachar sheakal veshata zeh venitgaa — qibbel alayv ol malkut shamayim. Lepikak, muttar lishtot mayim qodem hattepilla ap al pi shehem tzorek haggup, hoil velo shayyak bahem gaava. Vaapillu beshabbat veyom tob shetztzarik leqaddesh al hakkos lipne hasseuda — en haqqiddush osero millishtot qodem tepillat hashshachar, kevan sheadayin lo higgia zemanno, sheen qiddush ella bimqom seuda vesamuk lah, vahare i epshar lo leekol kelum qodem tepillat hashshachar. Vaapillu kol mine okalim vekol mine mashqin sheshshayyak bahem gaava — muttar leoklam velishtotam letzorek repua, sheen barepua mishshum gaava. Abal lirabo velitzmao — asur. Ella im ken eno yakol lekavven dato bitpillato ad sheyyokal o sheyyishteh. Vaapillu akshav sheen mekavvenim kol kak battepilla, mikkol maqom im rotzeh leekol velishtot kede lekavven — hareshut beyado:

Im hitchil leekol qodem alot hashshachar — tzarik lehapsiq kesheoleh ammud hashshachar. Veap al pi shebbitpillat hammincha en tzarik lehapsiq, mikkol maqom kan hoil veissur haakila qodem hattepilla hismikuhu chakamim al lo taaseh shebbattora shehu "lo toklu al haddam" — tzarik lehapsiq apillu hitchil behetter. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik lehapsiq litpilla apillu hitchil beissur, ella liqriat shema bilbad shehi min hattora tzarik lehapsiq im hitchil beissur, veqore qeriat shema belo birkoteha, shebbirkoteha hen middibre soperim. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Veim berak birkat hammazon veoseq bishtiyya — tzarik lehapsiq ledibre hakkol:

Apillu lilmod asur mishshehiggia zeman hattepilla im hu ragil lehitpallel bebet midrasho beyachid veeno ragil lelek lebet hakkeneset, yesh lachosh shemma yimmashek belimmudo veyaabor zeman qeriat shema utepilla. Abal mi sheragil lelek lebet hakkeneset — muttar lilmod bebeto ad sheat tepillat hatztzibbur. Veim hu melammed laacherim, apillu eno ragil lelek lebet hakkeneset — muttar, kevan shehashshaa oberet, shezzekut harabbim dabar gadol hu, veim lo yilmedu akshav yitbattelu velo yukelu lilmod achar kak. Ulepikak, apillu im nimshak belimmudo ad shezzeman qeriat shema utepilla ober — lo yapsiq millimmudo, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"v:

Muttar likkanes lammerchatz ulehistapper samuk leshacharit, shello gazeru ella samuk lemincha shehu dabar hammatzuy sherob haam niknasin sham bayyom, abal bashshachar dabar sheeno matzuy hu velo gazeru bo. Abal lahapok beorot vekol melaka kayyotze bah sheaseru samuk lemincha — asur gam samuk leshacharit, shehu dabar hammatzuy sheadam mashkim limlakto qodem alot hashshachar:

Bishat haddechaq, kegon shetztzarik lehashkim latzet ladderek, ben beraglayv ben beqaron o bispina, veen hashshayyara mamtenet lo ad achar netz hachamma lehitpallel tepillat y"ch kemitzvatah bebeto meummad — yakol lehitpallel mishsheala ammud hashshachar qodem tzeto. Veim heir kebar hayyom ad sheyyakkir et chabero berichuq d' ammot shehu zeman qeriat shema — yiqra gam qeriat shema ubirkoteha bebeto, veyismok geulla litpilla. Veim lo heir hayyom kol kak — yitpallel y"ch lebaddah bebeto meummad, veyamtin milliqrot qeriat shema ad sheyyaggia zemannah im epshar liqrotah badderek kemitzvatah, dehaynu sheyyaamod vikavven bepasuq rishon kemo shennitbaer besiman n"ch. Abal tepilla shehi tzerika amida bekullah — min hassetam lo yizdammen lo badderek lehitpallel meummad (shebbene hashshayyara lo yamtinu lo, o sheal yede kak yittared velo yukal lekavven kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"d). Lepikak tzarik lehitpallel meummad qodem tzeto, ap al pi sheeno somek geulla litpilla, vegam adayin lo higgia iqqar zemannah shehu netz hachamma, lepi shettepilla meummad shequla keneged kullam ugedola mehem. Veakshav en rob haolam nizharin bazeh, lepi shettepilla meummad enah gedola missemikat geulla litpilla ella mishshum sheomed yakol lekavven heteb, veakshav enan mekavvenim kol kak battepilla. Umikkol maqom, im hu badderek veyare shemma yaabor zeman qeriat shema veyadua lo sheyyaggia lammalon qodem sheyyaabor zeman tepilla — yakol liqrot qeriat shema bilbaddah, ulehamtin im birkoteha veim hattepilla ad sheyyaggia lammalon, kede lehitpallel meummad velismok geulla litpilla (abal min haddin en tzarik lehamtin kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"d):
